column3: Only one definition (camera.ts:18) and ArcRotate/Free/Geospatial (arc-rotate.ts:23, free-camera.ts:19, geospatial-camera.ts:46), XrCamera (xr-camera.ts:41) and BankedFreeCamera via FreeCamera do extend it; "every renderer consumes" is too broad to settle: renderable.ts:20 allows camera-less passes and pbr/standard/node/sprite/skybox renderables never name Camera

All 57 files import or re-export from ../camera/camera.js (no comment-only hits); next most-imported camera file has 3 outside importers (viewport.ts, free-camera.ts), so camera.ts is the main inbound dependency
getCameraPosition (camera.ts:230-233) is neither cached nor a matrix getter: it builds a fresh Vec3 from worldMatrix; only the other three use _viewCache/_projCache/_vpCache
camera.ts:189-197 compares fov/nearPlane/farPlane to _projFov/_projNear/_projFar, bumps _projRev on drift and returns worldMatrixVersion + _projRev
Not all gate uploads: xr-camera.ts:116 and shadow-base.ts:251 use the key to stamp _projVer/_vpVer cache fields, not to gate any per-frame upload

parentable.ts:14-18 states the rule for IWorldMatrixProvider.worldMatrixVersion (any world-matrix provider), not for a custom Camera; Camera does not extend IWorldMatrixProvider, and the custom-Camera rule is in camera.ts:181-183
Output lists the six direct assignments in scene-core.ts:338, xr-camera.ts:116/119/120, shadow-base.ts:249/251
Two of the nine lines are not readers: shader-renderable.ts:738 and geometry-renderer-task.ts:832 are doc comments; the one writer (scene-core.ts:337) is right

Most uses do not mirror Z: they flip yaw/alpha sign (free-camera-controls.ts:106, arc-rotate-controls.ts:438), pan/strafe X (arc-rotate-controls.ts:463, free-camera-controls.ts:119), swap cross-product order (geospatial-camera.ts:105-113) or flip X and Z columns (free-camera.ts:58-63); seven lines are just imports; only camera.ts:139-146 mirrors Z
src/engine/coordinate-system.ts matches only through a doc comment (line 4); it defines _rightHanded and does not read the switch, so 73 not 74 files read it
camera.ts:151-160 module-local _orthoProjector and setter with tree-shake comment; only caller is orthographic.ts:138 inside enableOrthographicCamera; branch at camera.ts:206
getProjectionMatrix uses ortho only when _orthoProjector !== null (camera.ts:206), and it is set only by enableOrthographicCamera (orthographic.ts:138); disable at orthographic.ts:146-157

Module-local slot arc-rotate-controls.ts:84 with setter :87, read at :262; installed from keyboard module by enableArcRotateKeyboardControls (arc-rotate-keyboard-controls.ts:165-166), same shape as the ortho seam

setCameraLimits (arc-rotate-controls.ts:146-185) is not an input function: it stores bounds and installs a self-clamp hook, no listeners; and they are not the only arc-rotate input functions (enableArcRotateKeyboardControls, arc-rotate-keyboard-controls.ts:165)
createFreeCamera calls _createFreeCamera with Vec3Up (free-camera.ts:38-40); _createFreeCamera is @internal and takes up (:42-47); createBankedFreeCamera wraps it (banked-free-camera.ts:43-46)
upVector ObservableVec3 and _markLocalMatrixDirty wiring only in banked-free-camera.ts:43-45; free-camera.ts has no upVector code, it just reads the passed up at :57
setCameraLimits' disposer (arc-rotate-controls.ts:180-184) only clears the _clampToLimits hook; it detaches no input and no before-render hook (no _beforeRender use there)

push/indexOf pairs in arc-rotate-controls.ts:496/519, free-camera-controls.ts:161/176, configurable-free-camera-controls.ts:158/172, geospatial-camera-controls.ts:760/783, geospatial-camera-fly.ts:143/132, each followed by splice(idx, 1)
arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:4 imports runFrameInterpolation from animation and :193 drives the step through it; frame-interpolation.ts:40 registers the driver on _beforeRender

arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:39-46 documents clampToLimit mirroring clampCameraToLimits so the goal resolves to the settled value; both use the same lower-then-upper bound logic (arc-rotate-controls.ts:96-120, arc-rotate-interpolate.ts:47-55)
Output shows definition at geospatial-limits.ts:34 and imports in geospatial-camera.ts:9, geospatial-camera-controls.ts:4, geospatial-movement.ts:10

Only computeLocalBasis, computeYawPitchFromLookAt (geospatial-camera-controls.ts:2) and normalizeRadians (geospatial-camera-fly.ts:2) are imported back; computeLookAtFromYawPitch and clampCenterFromPoles are imported by neither, only re-exported in index.ts:221-223
The only reference to the picking module in src/camera is the import at geospatial-camera-controls.ts:6 (used at :131); other "picking" hits are comments

frameDecay is not imported by the controls file: geospatial-camera-controls.ts:10 imports only REFERENCE_FRAME_RATE, integrateInertialVelocity, computePanSpeedMultiplier, computeZoomSpeedMultiplier; frameDecay is used only inside geospatial-movement.ts:36
Output shows SceneContext type imports from scene/scene.js (3 files) and scene/scene-core.js (3 files)
Output shows the re-export of getEffectiveAspectRatio from ./camera.js (viewport.ts:2) plus own FULL_VIEWPORT (:12) and resolveCameraViewport (:20)
Setter defined at camera.ts:241-253 (excluded from the command's output) calls setViewport and setScissorRect; its only callers are geometry-renderer-task.ts:897 and render-task-base.ts:566
world-to-screen.ts:44, :94, :149 take Mat4 parameters (world+transform, or view+viewProjection) and options; the file imports no camera module
Two blocks at index.ts:201-232 and :995-1004; not every export is public, e.g. _cameraChangeKey, FULL_VIEWPORT, frameDecay and the _install* functions do not appear in index.ts
